recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless a future issue asks core to restore local LOINC guidance or change THO links; future migrated-page wording maintenance belongs in HL7 Terminology/UTG.
issue_request: Published FHIR-core Vocabulary issue FHIR-22623, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, requested changing the LOINC answer-list paragraph from value set identifier/url wording to value set canonical uri/value set uri wording.
initial_application: Git commit 0bcb947d8488b993d882cc96e556cb3d1e84a94e included FHIR22623 in its message and changed source/loinc.html so the target paragraph used value set canonical uri and value set uri.
additional_context: Published FHIR-35933 and related UTG proposal UP-289 moved the external-code-system Using X pages, including Using LOINC, from FHIR core to HL7 Terminology. Commit 81e5862f203fdb8a03e9c943a7cf455aba8973f4 deleted source/loinc.html, removed loinc.html from the core hierarchy, and left current core source linking LOINC guidance to THO.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current FHIR-core source has no occurrence of the old LOINC answer-list paragraph, the active Code Systems page delegates external terminology guidance to THO, and the versioned THO LOINC page for the R5-era migration preserves the canonical-uri wording.
